description: Address code review findings: add monthly estimate clarification, lazy-load commission image, add ARIA tab roles, and clarify net cost claim in comparison table.
steps: Add clarification text to the monthly estimate in calculator results to prevent confusion about payment frequency.
Implement lazy-loading for the commission image by storing base64 data in a JS variable and only setting img src after password verification succeeds.
Add role='tablist' to the tab container UL and role='tab' with tabindex='0' to each tab LI element.
Add '(nominal, belum memperhitungkan nilai waktu uang)' clarification to the 'Biaya Bersih Proteksi: Rp 0' cells in the comparison table.
acceptance_criteria: Calculator monthly estimate includes text clarifying payment is annual only
Commission image src is empty on page load and only populated after successful password entry
Tab navigation elements have role='tablist' and role='tab' attributes
Comparison table net cost cells include time-value-of-money disclaimer
verification: python3 -c "f=open('MPS_Flexi_Product.html','r'); c=f.read(); f.close(); assert 'pembayaran hanya tahunan' in c; print('PASS: Monthly clarification')"
python3 -c "f=open('MPS_Flexi_Product.html','r'); c=f.read(); f.close(); assert 'var komisiImgData' in c; assert 'id=\"komisi-img\"' in c; print('PASS: Lazy-load image')"
python3 -c "f=open('MPS_Flexi_Product.html','r'); c=f.read(); f.close(); assert 'role=\"tablist\"' in c; assert 'role=\"tab\"' in c; print('PASS: ARIA roles')"
python3 -c "f=open('MPS_Flexi_Product.html','r'); c=f.read(); f.close(); assert 'nominal, belum memperhitungkan nilai waktu uang' in c; print('PASS: Net cost clarification')"
findings: All 4 review fixes applied. File size increased marginally (from 441KB to 441KB) due to added text. The base64 image data is now in a JS variable instead of inline in the img src attribute, enabling browsers to begin rendering the page before parsing the large base64 string.
